summary: The body of one record's single view: what defines the object on the main column, its state and metadata on the side.
not_for: A record of a handful of fields: record.summary-list alone.

rules.rule: The main column holds what defines the object; the side column its status, metadata and summaries.
Sections are ordered by importance, and like content sits in one section.
At 375px the side column follows the main column.

evidence.says: The details layout puts the information that defines the object in the primary column and status, metadata and summaries in the secondary column.
A full-page app places an overview and its details beside each other.
